question: Why does the frozen HGB trade/skip selector discard profitable executed trades, and can one causal change beat the all-trades baseline without validation tuning?
holdout: Events after anchor_utc remain unread and unused.

split.method: chronological 60/40 within each window on labeled executed episodes
split.purge: TRAIN labels must close before VALIDATION start minus one-hour embargo

baseline: ALL_TRADES on the same labeled executed validation cohort; net_jpy is actual realized_pl_jpy plus financing_jpy and therefore includes actual spread/fill slippage while opportunity cost remains unavailable.

missingness: label availability by episode status, pair, side, lane family, hour, weekday, causal forecast and decision-time intended-price availability
among labeled trades, causal forecast and thesis-record availability versus net JPY, win sign, pair, side, lane family and time
chi-square and Cramer's V for categorical association, Mann-Whitney U and bootstrap mean-difference CI for observed net association, and chronological logistic AUC for predictable label missingness
analyses.interpretation_guard: Observed association or predictability rejects MCAR and is compatible with MAR or MNAR. MNAR cannot be proven because counterfactual returns for missing labels are unobserved.
selection_attribution: selected versus excluded after-cost net, prediction rank and decile calibration
false-negative winners, false-positive losers, missed-winner JPY and avoided-loser JPY
incremental candidate-minus-all-trades net equals avoided loser magnitude minus missed winner JPY

one_variable_candidates.A_COVERAGE_BINDING: Apply frozen HGB only where a causal forecast exists; pass through forecast-missing episodes as TRADE.
one_variable_candidates.B_COST_AWARE_ABSTAIN: Choose a skip threshold only from chronological TRAIN out-of-fold predictions on a fixed quantile grid. A threshold qualifies only with at least 80% retention and positive TRAIN incremental net and paired LCB; otherwise fall back to all-trades. Validation labels cannot affect it.
one_variable_candidates.C_PAIR_SIDE_CALIBRATION: Add TRAIN-only mean residual by pair and side when group n>=20, otherwise the TRAIN global residual; selection threshold remains zero.
one_variable_candidates.D_X_CONTRACT: Admit only a completed external contract with status URL, executable entry, exit, invalidation and cost assumptions. Otherwise record WAITING or NOT_ADMITTED and do not infer missing rules.

acceptance.net_jpy: strictly greater than ALL_TRADES on the identical validation cohort
acceptance.drawdown_or_margin_alternative: A candidate that does not improve net may only be considered if a pre-registered material DD or margin improvement is statistically demonstrated; this run has no such separate threshold and therefore requires net superiority.
acceptance.stability: same contract on 16/32/64 days; no one-window adoption
acceptance.policy_admission: all-entry counterfactual coverage is still required before live or Paper use

source_reconstruction.allowed: existing frozen execution ledger, forecast history, projection ledger and entry-thesis ledger only
